title: Before I Go to Sleep
description: Terrifying new truths cause a woman (Nicole Kidman) with a memory disorder to question everything -- and everyone -- in her life.

title: The BeastMaster
description: Prehistoric Darwin uses ESP with animals to save a slave girl from a sorcerer.

title: A-X-L
description: Miles is a teenage motorcyclist who finds a gigantic robotic dog that's part of the military's artificial intelligence program. He must soon protect his new friend when it becomes the target of rogue scientists who want their creation back.

title: The Nut Job
description: A mischievous squirrel and his sidekick assemble a ragtag animal crew to get inside their town's nut shop and steal enough food for the winter.

title: Mother's Day
description: A pregnant photographer (Selma Blair) captures motherhood on film while re-examining her relationship with her estranged mom.

title: Flyboys
description: Several American youths volunteer for the French military before the U.S. enters World War I and later become a squadron of fighter pilots, the celebrated Lafayette Escadrille.

title: Sabotage
description: Members of an elite DEA task force are eliminated one by one following their successful robbery of a powerful drug cartel's safe house.

title: The Grey
description: A pack of hungry wolves pursues survivors (Liam Neeson, Frank Grillo, Dermot Mulroney) of a plane crash, who are trekking through the Alaskan wilderness to find civilization. title: Killer Elite
description: A formidable special-ops agent (Jason Statham) must cut his way through a team of assassins to rescue his kidnapped mentor (Robert De Niro).

title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
description: In the central story, Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) struggles with his inner demons and tries to maintain control until his former lover, Ava Lord (Eva Green), returns wanting his help to escape her abusive husband.

title: Season of the Witch
description: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.

title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest
description: A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.

title: The Host
description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: The Gunman
description: A former Special Forces soldier (Sean Penn) who has PTSD tries to reconnect with his longtime lover, but must first find out who wants him dead... and why.

title: Timecop
description: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

title: Point Break
description: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents. An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.
